children: Overview
Canada real estate investment trust's Q3 adjusted FFO per unit rose yr/yr
Q3 rental income and net operating income fell, mainly due to asset sales and lease terminations
Company reinstated monthly distribution, announced special cash distribution after failed $6.7 bln asset sale
Outlook
Company intends to declare a special cash distribution of about C$2.30 per unit before year-end, subject to lender approval
H&R REIT says it will pursue opportunities to surface value following failed arrangement transaction
Result Drivers
ASSET SALES & LEASE TERMINATIONS - Co said declines in rental income and net operating income were mainly due to asset sales and lease terminations
OFFICE LEASE EXPIRATIONS - Same-property net operating income fell, mainly from office segment due to Royal Bank of Canada lease expiration and Bell Canada lease termination
RESIDENTIAL SEGMENT PRESSURE - Fair value adjustments in residential segment driven by market softness, supply pressure and higher rent concessions
